checks.rationale: TASK-001-AC1 is incomplete: exact-file ancestor claims miss descendant conflicts (R1-TASK-001-001). AC2 and the remaining identity, revision, immutable envelope and error behavior are supported.
The ancestor conflict false negative violates semantic invariant 3. Pure domain scope, flat modules, service ownership and all task exclusions are otherwise respected.

ScopePath.overlaps at candidate lines 316-322 considers ancestry only for directory-prefix ancestors. ScopeClaim.conflicts_with propagates the reproduced false negative for exact-file ancestor write/write and write/read claims.

Invalid IDs, revisions, paths, digests, evidence, non-JSON values and cycles fail explicitly. DomainException propagates through a context manager while DomainError stays frozen. Pure values acquire no IO resources requiring cleanup.
Existing exact/prefix, Windows, normalization, cycle and mutation checks pass, but exact-file ancestors versus descendant files or directory claims remain an incorrect filesystem boundary.

The exact candidate focused suite passes 14 meaningful behavior/failure tests, and 21 vocabularies match schemas directly. Its missing ancestor-conflict regression allows R1-TASK-001-001; add both orders and write/write plus write/read coverage.
The only production addition is the pure common-value module. Owned tests and handoff are bounded; no ports, service DTOs, adapter, reducer, IO, package or registry changes were introduced.
Reconstructed Git name/status diff contains exactly the three permitted additions; clean frozen head, no renames, deletions or unrelated/prohibited changes.

Explicit typed flat-module interfaces and exports, frozen dataclass values, detached nested JSON and a separate throwable error wrapper are clear and maintainable; service-specific fields remain in later owners.

Path validation rejects absolute, traversal, Windows-device/ADS and unsafe Unicode forms, but exact-file ancestor scope conflicts can be missed. This weakens downstream isolation/scheduling at the scope trust boundary.

The task-owned handoff accurately documents identity, immutability, vocabularies, validation and no IO. Its conflict-detection coverage needs the ancestor correction and refreshed regression evidence before acceptance.

findings.description: At src/domain_values.py:316-322, ScopePath.overlaps only follows ancestors marked DIRECTORY_PREFIX. ScopePath("src/generated").overlaps("src/generated/value.py") and corresponding ScopeClaim write/write and write/read checks return false; case-normalized exact ancestors versus child directories also return false. A file at the ancestor cannot coexist with descendant paths, so downstream isolation or scheduling can admit filesystem-incompatible claims contrary to normalized ancestor scope invariants.
findings.expected_fix: Detect component-wise ancestor overlap in either direction independently of exact-file versus directory-prefix permission containment. Preserve contains/permits exact-file authorization semantics. Add ancestor file/child file and directory regressions in both orders for write/write and write/read claims, normalization aliases and disjoint siblings; refresh handoff, targeted evidence, candidate identity and both independent review stages.
